headline: Kiteworks urges customers to shut down servers over threat
summary: Kiteworks is urging customers worldwide to temporarily shut down their servers for a six-hour window on Saturday, after receiving what it calls a 'credible threat' from law enforcement warning of an imminent cyberattack tied to potential zero-day vulnerabilities.

claims.statement: Kiteworks is urging customers to temporarily shut down their servers due to an imminent cyberattack threat
